info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan By Payment Id-spec
info.description: The Delete Loan Payment API allows users to remove a specific payment associated with a loan by its unique payment ID. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and systems managing dynamic loan accounts, ensuring accurate records and up-to-date financial information. Typical consumers include loan servicing platforms and administrative users who need to resolve erroneous payments or manage adjustments. By invoking this API, users can ensure proper tracking of loan payment histories.

delete.summary: Delete a specific payment for a loan.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific payment associated with a particular loan. Ensure that the payment ID is correctly provided, as this action is irreversible and will remove all associated data permanently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific payment associated with a loan. Ensure that you include the necessary details to identify the payment for deletion.

204.description: The payment was successfully deleted, and there is no content to return.

DeleteLoanByPaymentIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation of a payment associated with a specific loan.

DeleteLoanByPaymentIdResponse_204.title: Loan Payment Deletion Response
DeleteLoanByPaymentIdResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response for the deletion of a loan payment operation.
